description.summary: A Cross-Encoder Reranker scores query-candidate pairs jointly for reranking.
description.description: A Cross-Encoder Reranker is a RAG component that jointly scores a query and candidate item pair so a reranking step can reorder candidates before context assembly.

responsibilities: Score query-candidate pairs jointly for reranking.

inputs.name: Query
inputs.description: The query used when scoring candidate pairs.

inputs.name: Candidate ranking
inputs.description: The candidate list to be reranked.

outputs.name: Reranked candidates
outputs.description: A candidate list reordered by joint query-candidate scores.
